versions.changelog:
- 修正 ocean 主题中文描述，从“深海主题”更正为“海洋主题”
- 其余内容无变动

Initial release of md-layout-engine:

- Converts Markdown into HTML cards with selectable themes.
- Supports four built-in themes: brick-red, ocean, forest, and minimal.
- Reads theme styles from YAML-format files in the themes/ directory.
- Applies all styles as inline CSS for each HTML element.
- Allows theme selection via comment, natural language, or defaults to brick-red.
- Outputs only a single HTML code block wrapped in a styled <div>.
